description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - Merchant Shipping (Life Saving appliances and Arrangements) Regulations No. 04 of 2021
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971. It establishes new legal requirements for life-saving appliances and arrangements on ships, giving effect to international maritime conventions. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves the creation of new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
